title: Loan Program Step on Rate Lock Commitment Extension Rates
content:
**Secondary marketing schedule: the loan program and the Rate Lock Commitment extension rate.**

The loan program of the **Mortgage Loan File** that a lock protects adds a step to the per-day cost of an extension, in basis points. The adjusted per-day cost is never taken below zero.

| Loan program of the file | Step added to the per-day cost (basis points) |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.5 (the jumbo step) |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 0.25 (the high-balance step) |
| Any other program (for example Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed) | none |

**Rule as stated.** A Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed file adds the jumbo step of 0.5 basis points. A Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed file adds the high-balance step of 0.25 basis points. Any other program adds none.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a product whose extension cost is 2.0 basis points per day, a Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed file with no other change prices the extension at 2.5 basis points per day.
